mapper.select: SELECT DEPT_ID, DEPT_NAME, PARENT_DEPT_ID, LEVEL AS DEPT_LEVEL FROM TB_DEPT START WITH PARENT_DEPT_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR DEPT_ID = PARENT_DEPT_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY DEPT_SORT_ORDER ASC
SELECT DEPT_ID, DEPT_NAME, DECODE(USE_YN, 'Y', '사용중', '미사용') AS USE_STATUS_NM, NVL(EMP_COUNT, 0) AS EMP_COUNT FROM TB_DEPT WHERE ROWNUM <= 50
